build_beam_search_sequence_generator: build a BeamSearchSequenceGenerator with a CausalLM model and vocabulary info for autoregressive text generation
build_beam_search_seq2seq_generator: build a BeamSearchSeq2SeqGenerator with a Seq2SeqModel for encoder-decoder translation generation
run_beam_search_generation: run the BeamSearchSequenceGenerator on prompt sequences to generate text with configurable beam size and temperature
run_seq2seq_beam_search_generation: run the BeamSearchSeq2SeqGenerator on source and prompt sequences to generate translated output sequences
register_step_hook: register a StepHook callback on the generator to observe each generation step during beam search
